mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 57-degree temperatures and overcast skies near Fireman's Park, with an air quality index of 52 marking a moderate alert level.

The City of Verona welcomes Deputy Chief Liz Gay to the EMS team. She joins us with an extensive background in emergency services and administration. Also, as a reminder, Pellitteri Waste Systems handles our weekly refuse and biweekly recycling collection, so please ensure your carts are placed correctly by 7 AM.

There is plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow is a big day for trivia lovers, with games at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers arrested a man for his first offence of O W I after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by for a treat.
